Rule.name: FSIEM-API-001
Rule.Description: Detects sequential or unauthorized access to API objects by ID indicating broken object-level authorization

Rule.name: FSIEM-API-002
Rule.Description: Detects API authentication attempts using default or well-known credentials

Rule.name: FSIEM-API-003
Rule.Description: Detects API responses returning sensitive properties that the user should not access

Rule.name: FSIEM-API-004
Rule.Description: Detects API requests exceeding rate limits indicating denial of service or scraping attacks

Rule.name: FSIEM-API-005
Rule.Description: Detects access to administrative API endpoints by non-administrative users

Rule.name: FSIEM-API-006
Rule.Description: Detects automated or excessive access to business-critical API flows like checkout, transfer, or account creation

Rule.name: FSIEM-API-007
Rule.Description: Detects SSRF attempts through API endpoints targeting internal networks or cloud metadata

Rule.name: FSIEM-API-008
Rule.Description: Detects unauthorized access to API documentation endpoints like Swagger, OpenAPI, or GraphQL introspection

Rule.name: FSIEM-API-009
Rule.Description: Detects access to undocumented or deprecated API endpoints not in the API inventory

Rule.name: FSIEM-API-010
Rule.Description: Detects API responses containing executable content or unsafe data that could harm downstream systems

Rule.name: FSIEM-API-011
Rule.Description: Detects mass assignment attacks where request parameters include unauthorized fields like role, isAdmin, or status

Rule.name: FSIEM-API-012
Rule.Description: Detects GraphQL queries with excessive depth or complexity indicating DoS or data extraction

Rule.name: FSIEM-API-013
Rule.Description: Detects JWT tokens with algorithm set to none or missing algorithm indicating authentication bypass

Rule.name: FSIEM-API-014
Rule.Description: Detects API responses returning more data than requested including PII, credentials, or internal fields

Rule.name: FSIEM-API-015
Rule.Description: Detects NoSQL injection operators ($where, $regex, $gt) in API request parameters

Rule.name: FSIEM-API-016
Rule.Description: Detects API key usage from unauthorized sources or with excessive permissions
